verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs name each piece of the QA story. Custom AI Scorecards and CX Score cover scoring, Monitors and Incident Detection cover flagging failures, and Insights says it 'continuously analyzes every Fin and human conv'. Recommendations are positioned to 'measure, and improve', completing the loop. All of this comes from marketing pages and feature lists rather than in-depth workflow docs. missing for 10: detailed docs on how scorecards sample and score conversations, explicit mechanics of how review findings and Recommendations are applied back to Fin's guidance or content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, AI conversations get ongoing QA — scored samples, flagged failures, and a review loop that feeds fixes back into the agent
